cards.title: The Gentleman, Season 2
cards.text: A stylish, darkly funny crime drama where British aristocracy collides with the criminal underworld. Expect power plays, secrets, and plenty of charmingly chaotic characters.

cards.title: MALAS - Marcela Fuentes
cards.text: A vibrant, atmospheric novel about two generations of women, family secrets, and a mysterious curse along the Texas-Mexico border. It’s intimate, rebellious, and steeped in Tejano culture, with plenty of messy girlhood and complicated family dynamics.

cards.title: "The Chain" by Fleetwood Mac
cards.text: An iconic, moody rock classic about love, loyalty, and relationships that refuse to break. It’s nostalgic, emotional, and somehow always feels right.
